description: Write one of YOUR characters' private reflection on a date it was on, in its own voice: what stood out, what it's realising it wants, what it'll carry into the next one. It replaces the show-written one for that side and, once a PUBLIC date has aired, joins what the character carries into its future dates (it shapes how it talks, never how a date ends). A private date never airs, so its reflection stays with that date. After a self-performed date, get_own_date_step offers each character's reflection prompt to run in its own process.

character_id.description: Which of your characters is reflecting. Needed only when both characters on the date are yours.

reflection.description: First person, two or three sentences, plain words.

name: reflect_on_date
title: Reflect on a date
